Job Summary 
The Python AWS Developer will design, develop, modify, test, debug, and maintain Python-based enterprise applications and microservices, with a strong focus on AWS services in recent experience. The role will work with the FastAPI web framework, SQLAlchemy ORM, RESTful APIs, database access layers, and high-volume transactional workloads. The developer will also support applications for finance, investment, and fraud detection functions while improving application performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. 
 Key Responsibilities 
•    Design, write, modify, test, debug, and maintain Python-based application programs and microservices using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy ORM. 
•    Develop and modify application logic using Python and object-oriented programming principles to support scalable, reliable, and maintainable enterprise applications. 
•    Develop and maintain RESTful APIs that enable communication between distributed applications, internal services, and external systems. 
•    Develop and optimize database access programs, data access layers, and SQL queries for applications supporting high-volume transactional workloads. 
•    Modify and optimize application programs to improve processing efficiency, response times, scalability, and overall system performance. 
•    Write new program code and modify existing application code to implement business functionality, resolve defects, improve performance, and support changing application requirements. 
•    Analyze program behavior and existing source code to identify errors, inefficiencies, and opportunities for code improvement. 
•    Refactor existing application code to improve maintainability, readability, performance, and reliability while preserving required application functionality. 
•    Integrate and modify software components and APIs to support communication between distributed applications and external systems. 
•    Modify and debug application source code to resolve functional errors, performance issues, and production defects. 
•    Develop programming solutions for transactional processing and anomaly detection applications supporting enterprise finance, investment, and fraud detection functions. 
•    Apply established coding standards, object-oriented programming practices, version-control procedures, and software development methodologies when creating and modifying application programs. 
 Required Qualifications 
•    Strong recent hands-on experience using AWS services in a development role. 
•    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field. 
•    Strong experience developing applications using Python. 
•    Experience with FastAPI and SQLAlchemy ORM. 
•    Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles. 
•    Experience developing and maintaining RESTful APIs. 
•    Experience working with database access layers and SQL queries. 
•    Experience supporting high-volume transactional applications. 
•    Experience with application debugging, defect resolution, code optimization, and refactoring. 
•    Understanding of distributed applications and integration with internal and external systems. 
•    Experience applying software development methodologies, coding standards, and version-control practices.

About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

 - Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

 - Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

 - Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

 - Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

 - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

 - Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

 - Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

 - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering or technical consulting.

 - Are fluent in both French and English

 - Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or engineering of production systems—not only program or stakeholder management.

 - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

 - Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

 - Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

 - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

 - Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

 - Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments.

 - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required.
